build: N2, bought-in plants. A planting is started from seed or bought in as plants or plugs: by its crop's Planted from, unless the planting says otherwise (plantings[].startedFrom), as the first planting of a season is bought in as plugs and the later ones sown; a planting made while its crop was set to bought-in plants keeps that through its own record of the crop. Bought in, it has no sowing day, cells, trays, seed or potting mix, and takes no room on a bench: it goes on Tasks as Plant out, and Seeds counts the plants its bed takes and the plan's spare on plugs, so a bought tray and a sown one give as many. Its harvest does not move. A variety may say who its plants or bulbs are bought from (buyFrom) and the lot they are sold in (buyLot): the shortfall is then rounded up to whole lots, and the order sheet lists it under that grower, beside seed; plugs of a crop otherwise sown are not listed under its seed house. A variety bought in for one planting and sown for another has a second line on Seeds. Marked as ordered and order arrived, as seed is.

changes.did: Bought-in plants: each planting can be sown or bought in, a bought-in one has no sowing, tray, mix or bench room, and Seeds counts its plants with spare, rounded up to the lot its grower sells.
steps: On Seeds, open a variety bought in as plugs for one planting: under In the plan its row reads Bought in, and Tasks has no sowing for it, only Plant out.
In that variety's panel, under Bought in, type the grower and the lot (72, say): its row's Vendor size reads so many × 72 plants.
Open the order sheet: the plants are listed under that grower, beside seed; Mark as ordered, then the order's arrival, as for seed.
